founder_updates.source_title: Kunal Shah steps down as CRED CEO to lead WhatsApp at Meta

log.found: Kunal Shah stepped down as CRED CEO in June 2026 to join Meta as WhatsApp global CEO. Meta invested $900M in CRED. Miten Sampat became interim CEO. Shah remains a shareholder.
Kunal Shah left operating role June 2026. He joined Meta/WhatsApp as global CEO. CRED valuation $4.5B.
